primitives.meaning: a previously engaged relationship that has passed the inactivity threshold defined for this context
entryFilters: a previously engaged relationship that has passed the inactivity threshold defined for this context
no instance of this journey is already open for the person
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.asks: Has this relationship ever been monetised in this context?

branches.label: Never paid
branches.test: no customer or paid relationship exists or has existed for this context

branches.label: Was a paying customer
branches.test: a monetised relationship exists or once existed

primitives.state: out of scope; belongs to win-back
primitives.reEntry: none here - restoring a relationship that was once paid for is a different problem with different economics and a different message, and treating it as reactivation gets both wrong

primitives.does: Establish whether there is a credible reason to come back: setup they never finished, an interest they expressed, something now relevant that was not before, a destination left incomplete, or a real change in the product

primitives.asks: Is there a credible reason, and is this person still eligible and contactable?

branches.label: Worth one attempt
branches.test: a specific reason exists and permission and eligibility both hold

branches.label: Not worth it
branches.test: no specific reason exists, or permission or eligibility has lapsed

primitives.state: dormant, no credible reason to re-engage
primitives.reEntry: a genuine change - in the product, in their circumstances, in what they asked for - can create a reason later; dormancy alone never becomes one by lasting longer

competition.precedence: lowest in the group - any current lifecycle on the same person outranks reactivation

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it
a valid token or app session exists and the message is a single step from the notification

primitives.purpose: Make one bounded attempt built on the recorded reason.
primitives.brief: Make one bounded attempt built on the recorded reason. Not a general note that they have been missed, which says nothing and asks for nothing

mustNotClaim: an offer policy does not enable

primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

cancelOn.meaning: real activity in the product or movement in the funnel - not a message open

primitives.reads: the person re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

primitives.does: Inspect what actually happened before declaring anything. Opening the message is not returning; the question is whether any real state moved

primitives.asks: What state did they actually return into?

branches.label: Unfinished onboarding
branches.test: an onboarding instance is open and setup resumed

branches.label: Renewed commercial intent
branches.test: behaviour shows intent stronger than what is currently recorded

branches.label: No current qualification
branches.test: they are back but nothing on record says whether they are qualified for anything now

branches.label: Signal did not survive inspection
branches.test: what looked like a return turns out to be engagement with the message and nothing more

carries: the milestones already completed, so they resume rather than restart

primitives.on: a return carrying stronger intent than the record holds
carries: the dormancy, so this is not read as a first-time interest

primitives.on: a return with no current qualification on record
carries: the earlier history and why it lapsed

primitives.reEntry: the window continues to its end if it has not expired; a click is not recorded as a return, because doing so would make this journey report its own message as a result

primitives.state: reactivation window closed, cooldown in force
primitives.reEntry: only a new reason, not a longer silence; repeated dormancy does not entitle anyone to repeated campaigns
